title: Automatic vertical slice: the card-game composition (command-driven set collection)
gateSentence: Run narrative and cards with the same kernel. Show zero idle command steps, automatic existing/future targets, a narrative state change and a card domain transfer.
gateSentenceSource: docs/game-core/09-implementation-guide.md, Wave 3 — Two genuinely different running compositions
resultNote: Nothing in this change set has been compiled, imported or executed on the authoring host: it has no .NET SDK, no C# compiler, no Mono and no Unity. Every result field in this document is the literal 'NotRun (pending orchestrator build host)' until tools/run_gc011.sh (or the individual commands below) has run on the Linux build host and its raw logs are archived beside this file. A suite result may only be replaced by Pass when the archived player log, EditMode xml, trx and probe JSON exist and agree with the assertions listed here.

observations.name: cards-catalog-and-declarations
observations.shows: the committed catalog resolves the card plugin factory (FactoryKind.PluginFactory) and the configuration schema, every generated-style declaration is accepted, an unregistered key is a MissingDependency miss and the key derivation holds (P-009, P-028)

observations.name: cards-ownership-and-schedule-compiled
observations.shows: GC-007 and GC-009 build one real descriptor: four stages, four systems, one playback point, a declared validate-to-commit buffer edge, one owner per declared domain and every slot policy validated (P-034, P-040, P-043)

observations.name: cards-world-and-market-seeded
observations.shows: a CommandDriven world is created in Automatic mode, the market's scope tree and the table runtime are mounted as control-lane edits, and the six live targets (four seats, the table, the scoreboard) are seeded in real ECS storage (P-006, P-032)

observations.name: cards-mount-reaches-existing-seats
observations.shows: the festival provider mounted at League A reaches seats A and B (+2) and the quiet provider at League B reaches seat C (+1) with no per-instance import, while the ineligible scoreboard and the isolated practice seat receive no row, and mounting awards no points (P-013, P-015, P-016)

observations.name: cards-idle-before-command-commits-zero-steps
observations.shows: eight host frames of a CommandDriven world before any command commit zero logical steps, publish nothing and leave no demand (P-035, P-036)

observations.name: cards-one-command-commits-both-sides
observations.shows: one admitted SubmitSet commits in one logical step: three cards leave seat A's hand, its score becomes 16 (seeded 4 + 10 base + 2 festival) and the table advances to version 2, turn 1, with exactly one committed event carrying delta 12 over three cards and matching live state (P-042, P-044, P-045)

observations.name: cards-duplicate-command-transfers-once
observations.shows: the same request key submitted twice executes once: the second submission returns the recorded result, the giver's hand shrank by exactly one card and the step counter advanced once (P-037, P-050)

observations.name: cards-rejected-settlement-changes-nothing
observations.shows: an admitted command whose gameplay the domain rejects still commits an observable rejected result in a logical step, and no hand, score or table version moves (P-037, P-042)

observations.name: cards-transfer-commits-both-sides
observations.shows: one transfer commits both sides in one step: the receiver gained exactly the card the giver lost, no card was copied and the table advanced once (P-044)

observations.name: cards-batch-envelope-resolves-one-winner
observations.shows: the declared atomic batch envelope (P-037) travels its own route: one admitted contest envelope carries two paired candidates, is decoded by the reader bound to its schema, and exactly one bid consumes the contested card - the holder loses it, the smallest (seat, sequence) bidder gains it, the losing bidder's hand is unchanged and the table advances once (07 s2.3, P-042, P-044)

observations.name: cards-future-seat-inherits-modifier
observations.shows: a seat created after the provider mounted obtains the same +2 contribution in its first visible image, with no local import, and is published only with its complete assembly at one epoch (P-013, P-024)

observations.name: cards-idle-world-performs-zero-steps
observations.shows: after the last command the world is idle again: eight frames commit zero steps, run no dispatch and leave no demand (P-035, P-036)

observations.name: cards-teardown-settles-and-disposes
observations.shows: the world stops cleanly, its retained jobs settled, no host resource stayed retained and the owned-world registry returned to its pre-run size (P-047, P-048)

requirementEvidence.claim: the card slice adds no actor, action, turn, combat, physics, animation, resource or reward schema to the kernel; a plugin scope is composition membership, not an ECS parent or a Transform, and the composition tree, the ECS entity graph and the scope tree are separate structures
requirementEvidence.evidence: cards-world-and-market-seeded (one table runtime owns several entities across scopes, so there is no one-to-one plugin/scope/entity mapping); cards-ownership-and-schedule-compiled (every declared domain names a logical owner, not an entity); the package surface: Packages/com.gamecore.gameplay.cards declares only card components, and Packages/com.gamecore.rules.cards references no Unity assembly at all

requirementEvidence.claim: the three kinds of change stay distinct: the scoring modifier is a CapabilityContribution with provenance, the provider mounts and the rule-library unmount are ManagedResourceEffect with a lifetime, and a settled set is a GameplayEffect that no later retraction or disposal undoes
requirementEvidence.evidence: cards-mount-reaches-existing-seats (a contribution installs a derived binding row and awards no points); cards-one-command-commits-both-sides (the committed score and hand are authoritative gameplay state, not a re-derivable contribution); cards-future-seat-inherits-modifier (unmounting the rule library is a managed-resource change whose publication leaves every seat's state and modifier untouched)

requirementEvidence.claim: one world-level Automatic mode makes every Descendants rule reach all eligible targets inside its scope domain, including targets created later, with no target imports
requirementEvidence.evidence: cards-world-and-market-seeded (PropagationMode.Automatic is the lane's committed mode); cards-mount-reaches-existing-seats (SeatABonusValue == SeatBBonusValue == CardVocabulary.FestivalBonus, SeatCBonusValue == CardVocabulary.QuietBonus, and the eligible-but-isolated practice seat and the ineligible scoreboard get no row); cards-future-seat-inherits-modifier (SpawnedSeatBonusValue == CardVocabulary.FestivalBonus before the seat's first executable step)

requirementEvidence.claim: eligibility comes from immutable reusable descriptors: the seat recipe advertises the scoring target schema and derives a row, the market table recipe advertises its own contract, and the scoreboard recipe advertises neither and stays on its base layout
requirementEvidence.evidence: cards-mount-reaches-existing-seats (SeatABonusRowCount == 1, ScoreboardRowCount == 0, PracticeSeatBonusRowCount == 0, ReducerRegistrations >= 3 with PredicateEvaluations reported); the recipes are declared once in CardTableRecipes and applied to every instance, including the future seat

requirementEvidence.claim: a spawned target is validated against the current composition revision and first becomes visible with its complete effective assembly and its ownership binding, at one epoch, with no frame of manual wiring
requirementEvidence.evidence: cards-future-seat-inherits-modifier (spawn.Outcome == Published and IsSpawn, CountersJoinedAfterSpawn, SpawnedSeatStampEpoch == WorldEpochAfterSpawn, SpawnedSeatStampPublished, SpawnedSeatInView, ForwardDerivationHadNoTargetChange for the publication the spawn rides on)

requirementEvidence.claim: every authoritative domain has one owner, its systems write only their declared slots and one commit stage settles the table entity and every seat entity as one multi-entity decision; partition disjointness is validated, not asserted by query predicates
requirementEvidence.evidence: cards-ownership-and-schedule-compiled (SingleOwnerPerDomain over all five declared slots, OwnershipDomainCount == 5, ValidatedSlotPolicyCount >= 5 with every policy succeeded, WriterCount == CompiledStageCount == 4); cards-one-command-commits-both-sides (CommittedWrites == CardSetRules.SetCardCount + 2 is the one bounded write set the single owner applied)

requirementEvidence.claim: a world chooses CommandDriven at creation and then advances only for an accepted command or a registered wake, so no inputs and no wakes means zero logical steps while composition processing may still continue
requirementEvidence.evidence: cards-world-and-market-seeded (CardTableRegistration.CommandDrivenRequest); cards-idle-before-command-commits-zero-steps and cards-idle-world-performs-zero-steps (IdleStepsCommitted == 0, IdleDispatchRuns == 0, PendingDemandAfterIdle == 0 over eight host frames each, with no step, no image and no wake)

requirementEvidence.claim: each step seals its admitted batch with a monotonic admission sequence; a CommandDriven world admits one pending command per step; duplicate request keys return their recorded result instead of executing again; and a domain rejection still commits an observable rejected result in a logical step
requirementEvidence.evidence: cards-one-command-commits-both-sides (StepsAfterCommand == 1); cards-duplicate-command-transfers-once (DuplicateRejections >= 1, StepsAfterDuplicate == 2, SeatBHandAfterDuplicate == SeededHandCount - 1, PendingDemandAfterDuplicate == 0); cards-rejected-settlement-changes-nothing (the rejected request still advanced exactly one step and produced RejectedDecisionCount >= 1)

requirementEvidence.claim: the host validates the envelope and the state owner validates the gameplay, so admission acceptance is not gameplay success; the committed result names the event the step published
requirementEvidence.evidence: cards-one-command-commits-both-sides (CommandAdmitted and CommittedEventMatchesLiveState over the same values live ECS storage holds); cards-rejected-settlement-changes-nothing (RejectedCommandAdmitted is true while RejectedRequestKind is the domain's rejection, with no state change); cards-duplicate-command-transfers-once (the second submission is a recorded result, not a second execution)

requirementEvidence.claim: each buffer declares schema, lifetime, producers, exactly one consuming owner, order key, capacity and overflow behavior, and no consumer reads a buffer before its producer completed
requirementEvidence.evidence: cards-ownership-and-schedule-compiled (BufferEdgeValidateBeforeCommit is a real producer-to-consumer stage edge from cards.validate to cards.commit, InputStageIndex < CommitStageIndex, one playback point); cards-one-command-commits-both-sides (CommittedWrites == 5 stays inside CardSetRules.MaxWriteEntries == 12 and one entry inside CardTableKeys.DraftCapacity == 8)

requirementEvidence.claim: a multi-entity atomic decision gathers intents, validates versions and resources, computes one bounded write set and applies it under its single owner before any tentative receipt becomes a committed event; the step advances only after the required drains and the consistent snapshot are prepared
requirementEvidence.evidence: cards-one-command-commits-both-sides (exactly one committed event, its delta/score/table version equal to live state, the logical step advanced once); cards-transfer-commits-both-sides (both hands moved in one step, no conservation violation: TransferGainedCard == 1 and TransferLostCard == 0); cards-rejected-settlement-changes-nothing (a rejection writes nothing)

requirementEvidence.claim: the card slice extends the kernel only through registered seams: a precompiled plugin factory, a registered Int32 sum reducer, a registered static predicate, four registered system factories and a registered schema serializer, all resolved by key from the committed generated catalog and never by reflection
requirementEvidence.evidence: cards-catalog-and-declarations (the factory lookup is a PluginFactory, every generated-style declaration is accepted, key derivation holds, and an unregistered key is reported MissingDependency rather than constructed); CardCatalog.g.cs: RegistrationGroupCount == 4 and SchemaCount == 1 with direct constructor references

requirementEvidence.claim: the card composition executes with the same kernel binaries and adds no mandatory kernel gameplay schema or phase, which is what the genre validation before freeze requires
requirementEvidence.evidence: the twelve observations run over two catalogs in one process (the committed generated catalog and the hand-written generated-style one), the slice's whole assembly reference list is kernel packages plus the card package, and no kernel source file was modified by this slice (see HANDOFF section 'Kernel changes')

testSuiteEvidence.clauseCovered: repeat the propagation case with a card-rule provider and with a non-spatial target lacking any GameObject
testSuiteEvidence.evidence: cards-mount-reaches-existing-seats plus cards-future-seat-inherits-modifier on both catalogs, and the EditMode case AFutureSeatInheritsTheModifierOnFirstVisibility: every eligible existing and future target receives the expected derived assembly, incompatible (scoreboard) and isolated (practice) targets do not, and the card slice has no Transform or GameObject at all

testSuiteEvidence.clauseCovered: use a card resource transfer rather than combat arbitration: direct owner writes inside one stage, bounded request buffers, duplicate requests, stale versions, rejection, and conservation
testSuiteEvidence.evidence: cards-one-command-commits-both-sides, cards-duplicate-command-transfers-once, cards-rejected-settlement-changes-nothing and cards-transfer-commits-both-sides, with the ownership half in cards-ownership-and-schedule-compiled (one owner per domain, validated slot policies, the declared decision buffer)

testSuiteEvidence.clauseCovered: run the command-driven card game and assert that it registers no compulsory combat, actor, action, vitality, physics or animation state/stage
testSuiteEvidence.evidence: the card package declares only its own tables, hands, scores and settlement stages; the generated card catalog registers one plugin factory, one reducer, one predicate and four system factories, none of them gameplay-genre state; the same kernel assemblies drive the narrative and W2 gates (artifacts/w2-gate) on the same revision

blockingDiagnostics.note: A `cards-edit-<Subject>` step only exists when a composition edit was refused, so its presence is a failure even though its name carries no observation number. tools/unity/run_cards_probe.sh fails on any `"status": "Fail"` outcome in the result, whichever name it carries, and GameCore.Cards.Tests fails on any such step as well.

revisionRecording.note: docs/game-core/08-validation-and-performance.md, 'Evidence and test layers': each run records the source revision, content and catalog hashes, exact Editor and package lock versions, OS and CPU architecture, machine model, worker count, scripting backend, stripping level, Burst configuration, safety-check settings, seed and input/observation trace. The probe result JSON carries the platform, architecture, scripting backend, stripping level and catalog fields; the package lock and player binary hashes belong beside it in artifacts/gc-011/toolchain.
